create_scheduler_priority_queue: create a Scheduler instance with optional polling interval and Redis cache for model request prioritization
add_request_to_queue: add a FlowItem request to the priority queue sorted by priority value for a specific model name
poll_queue_for_processing: poll the scheduler queue to determine if a request can be processed based on healthy deployments or queue position
remove_request_from_queue: remove a specific request from the priority queue when it times out while waiting for a model deployment
peek_queue_top_position: peek at the scheduler queue to check if a request ID is at the top without removing it
